newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Man sets himself ablaze on Red Square.
newsitem.headline: Man sets himself ablaze on Red Square.

text.p: A man set himself ablaze on Thursday in a suicide bid on Red Square shortly after President Boris Yeltsin gave a keynote policy speech in the Kremlin to Russian parliamentarians, police said.
The 60-year-old man, who was not identified, received serious but not life-threatening burns, a police spokesman said. He doused himself with liquid from a bottle and then set himself ablaze.
He was later recovering in a Moscow hospital.
The police spokesman said a preliminary investigation suggested the man was desperate over the miserable condition of his life during these difficult times in Russia.
Yeltsin told deputies in his annual state-of-the-nation address that urgent measures were needed to resolve Russia's many economic and social problems and combat crime and corruption.
